language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi! I’m Davey the Dragon.
My job here in the castle is to make sure everything is just right for Princess Portia!
She is on her way home from a long journey as we speak. Princess Portia is picky about position and symmetry,
so we want to make sure everything in a castle is in the right place and has symmetry before she gets back from her journey.
Position means where something is in relation to something else. For example,
now Chip is above the castle.
now Chip is below the castle.
Now Chip is next to the castle.
and now Chip is between these two chimneys.
Princess Portia also likes symmetry.
Symmetry means you can draw a line down the middle of something and it is the same on both sides.
Like this drawing of a face!
You can draw a line down the center of this face
and you will notice that the left side is a mirror image of the right side.
An easy way to tell if something has symmetry is to fold it in half on the line.
But look what happens when I use a side view of this face.
It is not symmetrical. There is no line that we can draw on this picture.
and have the mirror image on both sides, so we know it’s not symmetrical.
